submission.justification: This is a conditional recommendation. Statistical-only MC scans give these significances. S3: 3.69σ at 30%, 4.16σ at 45%, 4.22σ at 50%, 4.13σ at 55%, 3.78σ at 70%. S2: 3.30σ at 30%, 3.44σ at 45%, 3.34σ at 50%, 3.27σ at 55%, 3.27σ at 70%. S1: 2.35σ at 30%, 2.51σ at 50%, 2.38σ at 70%. These results match the 2025 summary (4.1, 3.4 and 2.6σ at 50%). S3 at about 50% efficiency is the best option for the stated goal. However, none of the project documents contain data/MC comparisons from the signal-free validation region. That means the hard ≤10% mismodelling constraint could not be checked for any strategy. The risk is highest for S3 because it relies on jet substructure variables, which are often poorly modelled. Before the selection freeze next month, the validation-region data/MC agreement must be checked for every input variable S3 uses. If any variable disagrees by more than 10%, drop S3. The next fallback is S2 (kinematics only, best at about 45% efficiency, 3.44σ), then S1 if S2 also fails. All significances exclude systematic uncertainties.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible expected signal significance
requirements.evidence: Of all scanned points, S3 at 50% efficiency gives the highest value, 4.22σ (statistical only). The best S2 point is 3.44σ at 45% and the best S1 point is 2.51σ at 50%.
